daily.title: Choreographer behind Kylie's grand final show prepares to reveal final work
daily.summary: As Rafael Bonachela prepares to leave Sydney Dance Company, his final full season as artistic director looks to both its history and the next generation of dancers and choreographers.

daily.title: Veteran rugby prop cited for allegedly grabbing opponent's genitals
daily.summary: Veteran Ireland prop Leinster's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for allegedly grabbing the genitals of Munster's Gavin Coombes during their United Rugby Championship match last weekend.

daily.title: Country residents paying three times to keep local doctors
daily.summary: With country councils paying big money to attract and retain GPs, a report has found residents are paying up-front, rates and Medicare contributions for medical services.

daily.title: Breaking: Earthquake reported by residents around Adelaide
daily.summary: Residents around Adelaide have reported feeling an earthquake this morning, with one saying he heard a rumble when his potplants started shaking.

daily.title: Fines of up to $120k for dumping pet fish in Adelaide river
daily.summary: With more than a dozen suspected pest koi carp spotted in the River Torrens, locals are being urged not to dump unwanted pet fish.

daily.title: Live: Anthropic to hit stock market with 'eye-popping' growth and massive losses
daily.summary: The AI giant behind Claude has filed its plans to float on the share market. Wall Street has rallied, led by tech stocks. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: Sydney University hires Jacinda Ardern as lecturer and mentor
daily.summary: The former New Zealand prime minister has been appointed a professor of practice, with a focus on empathetic leadership, social cohesion and civic trust.

daily.title: Prison officers fear deaths in custody under Queensland bill
daily.summary: Queensland prison staff fear a human rights exemption for prisoners will make their jobs more dangerous.

daily.title: Experts warn gas scheme ripe for manipulation
daily.summary: Historic legislation to establish a national gas reservation scheme is before federal parliament. Experts say the biggest driver of high prices could slip free.

daily.title: De Minaur pulls off massive comeback to improve ATP Finals hopes
daily.summary: It looked like goodnight Vienna for Alex de Minaur as he trailed Tomas Machac by a set, a break and 0-30 on his own misfiring serve.

daily.title: MP claims Melbourne property allowance despite attendance concerns
daily.summary: A Geelong-region state MP claims almost $60,000 in taxpayer-funded allowances for a second home in Melbourne, despite appearing to have missed 88 of a possible 127 Parliamentary sitting days.

daily.title: Roosters stunningly withdraw contract offer to halfback Sam Walker
daily.summary: Sam Walker's future at the Sydney Roosters is uncertain after the club pulled a contract extension offer to the premiership-winning halfback.

daily.title: Decomposing whale carcass re-emerges on Sydney's Malabar Beach
daily.summary: Randwick Council closes a Sydney beach after at least two large pieces of decomposing whale washed ashore.

daily.title: Live: Nine politicians get electorate office security upgrades after Haines attack
daily.summary: Nine parliamentarians will receive security upgrades to their electoral offices after raising concerns in the wake of the alleged attack on Helen Haines last week. Follow live.

daily.title: October rainfall records under threat across south-east Queensland
daily.summary: Brisbane and the Gold Coast are on track for their wettest October in six years as the Bureau of Meteorology predicts more showers and thunderstorms across south-east Queensland.

daily.title: Farmers wear cost as starving flying foxes damage banana, berry crops
daily.summary: Tens of thousands of bananas are ruined as starving bats search for food on NSW Mid North Coast farms.

daily.title: Mildura becomes home of the Big Sultana
daily.summary: Mildura's newest tourist attraction is big, brown and shrivelled but has a smile as welcoming as the mighty Murray River.

daily.title: Age pensioners who want to keep working say system punishes them
daily.summary: Peter Gibney says he doesn't want to stop working and nor can he afford to. He says he's being punished for that by the age pension system.

daily.title: Pervasive stigma still driving drug deaths, advocates say
daily.summary: Despite being the first Australian jurisdiction to decriminalise some drug use, advocates say people are still dying from preventable overdoses, in part due to a narrative that "others" them.

daily.title: Labuschagne must beat mental block to overcome the 30s in third Test
daily.summary: Australia are set to favour Marnus Labuschagne's ability to soak up pressure against the new ball and help the batters around him, and to give him one more chance for the third Test in South Africa.

daily.title: Medical centre targeted in Melbourne arson attack
daily.summary: Police are investigating a suspected arson attack at the Moonee Vale Clinic overnight, as well as a separate incident outside a Brighton home.

daily.title: Child protection 'informally' removed SA children against mothers' wishes
daily.summary: Child protection workers acted in error when they "informally" placed three South Australian children in the care of family members, against their mothers' wishes, the state's Ombudsman has found.

daily.title: Victoria crowned 'deadliest' state for racehorses by activists
daily.summary: The group behind the "Nup to the Cup" campaign has released its report into racehorse deaths both on and off the track across Australia.

daily.title: Tough new testing rules for sunscreens in the wake of SPF scandal
daily.summary: The long-awaited details of proposed reforms to the sunscreen industry have been released by the medicines regulator.

daily.title: Failed stadium bidder understood to get millions reimbursed
daily.summary: A failed bidder in the tender to build Hobart's stadium is set to have its costs reimbursed by the Tasmanian government — up to an amount the ABC understands is in the millions.

developing.title: Live: Bank of America fined $US1.2 billion for anti-money laundering failures
developing.summary: The ASX is set to slip after a slightly negative finish on Wall Street. Bank of America is hit with a record fine by the US Treasury. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: PM claims credit for delay of ATO credit card ban
developing.summary: Anthony Albanese reveals he had personally intervened ahead of the tax office's decision to delay a credit card ban after a plea from a peak business lobby. Follow live.

developing.title: Breaking: Greens senator takes leave amid allegations of comments towards women
developing.summary: The Greens say WA senator Jordon Steele-John has taken leave after reports of allegations that he made inappropriate comments towards women.

developing.title: Live: Moses and Ponga injured, Walsh vomits as Australia win all-time classic
developing.summary: Australia has won a classic World Cup clash against New Zealand, with debutant Jack Bostock scoring a match-winning hat-trick. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: ASX set to rise as Aussie dollar hits three-month low
developing.summary: Australian shares are expected to climb after Wall Street ended higher, despite investors shifting away from high-profile AI stocks into other sectors. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Shoebridge says he had 'discussion' with Steele-John before leave of absence
developing.summary: Greens leader David Shoebridge says Jordon Steele-John will not attend parliament while allegations are investigated. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Radio National counts down nation's favourite homegrown reads
developing.summary: Australia's favourite local reads are being revealed in Radio National's Top 100 Books countdown. Join us live as we count down to #1.

developing.title: Live: Rain curtails opening session after just five overs
developing.summary: Australia looks to build on its spectacular first Test victory over South Africa when the series moves to Gqeberha in the Eastern Cape. Follow all the day one action live.
